title: Hereditary
notes: Absolutely terrifying! Toni Collette's performance was incredible. The family dynamics and supernatural elements blend perfectly.

title: Midsommar
notes: Beautiful and disturbing in equal measure. The cinematography was stunning, especially the daylight horror scenes.

title: The Witch
notes: Atmospheric masterpiece. The period-accurate dialogue and authentic feel transported me completely.

title: Parasite
notes: Brilliant social commentary wrapped in a thrilling narrative. Every scene serves a purpose.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
notes: Non-stop action masterpiece. Practical effects and cinematography are phenomenal.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
notes: Mind-bending multiverse adventure with incredible heart. Michelle Yeoh is outstanding.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
notes: Whimsical and visually stunning. Ralph Fiennes delivers perfect comedic timing.

title: Blade Runner 2049
notes: Worthy successor to the original. Stunning visuals and deep philosophical questions.
